name: Hornby OO Sectional Track
description: Hornby OO 16.5 mm gauge sectional track in Code 100 nickel-silver rail. Widely used in UK starter sets. R-numbered SKUs - R600 series for straights and curves, R8200/R8261 for newer 4th-radius range. Compatible with Peco Setrack / Streamline Code 100 via standard rail-joiners; shared 1st (371 mm), 2nd (438 mm), 3rd (505 mm) and 4th (572 mm) radius convention. Both Hornby curves and Peco Setrack curves are nominally 22.5 deg per piece (16 per circle).

data_quality_note: Generated 2026-05-05 by an agent without working WebFetch/WebSearch access. Geometry math (length_mm = in*25.4; curve length = 2*pi*r*deg/360) is hand-computed and high-confidence. Product codes (SKUs) and source_url values are derived from training-data recall and were NOT live-verified. source_verified_at is null on every piece until a session with web access re-checks the catalog. See docs/library-notes/hornby-oo.md for per-system caveats.
